## 2. Project Goal

Build the local-first **中国地下电子音乐图鉴** data and consumer pipeline from WeChat articles plus OCR/social/radio enrichment. The knowledge graph is the atlas data layer; Stage7 owns the structured-extraction / graph-staging part of the whole pipeline:

```text
source discovery / archive / OCR / Markdown / LLM text evidence
  -> stable Stage7 article/entity/event extracts
  -> graph candidate packs / Neo4j Stage7Staging / production graph marker
  -> 1024-d isolated BGE-M3 / Snowflake / English sidecar vector lanes
  -> bounded network/social evidence
  -> downstream consumer packs
```

The local full SQLite atlas database is now materialized for the `138,102` atlas base, with a local DB-backed explorer/API, persistent adjudication ledger, map geocode layer, and geocode review queue. The CloudRun Stage7 API consumer release plus dedicated browser, identity review, and article/entity/event detail surfaces are remote-effective as `weekly-api-038` and preserved through the later weekly re-sync. Mini-program upload/review submission remains a separate surface. Execution evidence must still distinguish authorization, local package build, local database build, local explorer process, uploaded package, remote-effective API state, and mini-program state.

DeepSeek is treated as a text extraction lane. Image evidence must enter through OCR before Markdown/DeepSeek input; do not expect DeepSeek API to inspect images directly.
